starvation_episode.interpretation: Persistent pursuit of a visible but physically unreachable target; moving orbit prevented the ordinary physical-wedge detector from representing the failure.

reachable_target_control.interpretation: A provisional 45-60 second persistence boundary separates this run's ordinary approaches from the starvation fixation, but requires replication before motor use.

reward_supported_local_entrapment.interpretation: Repeated local rewards can suppress deprivation-driven relocation even when spatial coverage stagnates.

required_signals: low orbit efficiency or low net displacement

claim_boundary: One starvation fixation and several repeated-reward regions establish useful counterexamples, not a validated target-abandonment controller.
